application.zh: 無痕軋盒、減少毛邊、提升軋紙速度一成以上、減少後續加工時間與損耗，可讓紙張正反面雙凸。
application.en: Enables clean die-cutting with reduced burrs, increases cutting speed by over 10%, reduces post-processing time and waste, and supports double-sided embossing.

scope.zh: 紙盒軋切、彩盒加工、瓦楞包裝
scope.en: Carton die-cutting, color box processing, corrugated packaging

application.zh: 用於壓切支撐與成型穩定，各種尺寸皆可訂製，亦可修改或訂製子母板。
application.en: Provides cutting support and forming stability. All sizes available; parent-child plates can be customized or modified.

application.zh: 用於紙盒壓線成型，提升摺線品質與一致性。常規與客製規格皆可供應。
application.en: For paper creasing and folding, improving fold quality and consistency. Standard and custom sizes available.

name.zh: 快速除屑器（本公司專利）

application.zh: 代替傳統下針方式，能重複使用，操作簡易、快速上手。本公司專利產品。
application.en: Replaces traditional ejection pins. Reusable, easy to operate, and quick to set up. Patented by Jinli Laser.

application.zh: 快速除去廢料，減少人力成本、節省時間。
application.en: Quickly removes waste material, reducing labor costs and saving time.

specs.zh: 機型：電動 / 氣動；敲紙寬度：寬版 / 窄版
specs.en: Type: Electric / Pneumatic; Width: Wide / Narrow

application.zh: 用於清廢作業，協助廢料脫離成品。
application.en: Used in waste stripping to separate waste from finished product.

scope.zh: 財順用模切設備（3孔座 / 5孔座）

application.zh: 高速鋼材質，可自行研磨，用於刀模打齒加工。
application.en: High-speed steel construction, user-sharpenable, for perforating die processing.

application.zh: 用於刀片研磨與加工。提供金鑽石砂輪片與一般基本砂輪片兩種。
application.en: For blade grinding and processing. Available in diamond and standard types.

application.zh: 安裝於刀模刀片兩側，協助裁切後材料脫離刀片。
application.en: Mounted alongside cutting rules to help material release after cutting.

application.zh: 用於刀模底板修補與調整。
application.en: For base board repair and adjustment on cutting dies.

specs.zh: 白色（20條裝）/ 牛皮（10條裝）

application.zh: 用於刀模壓力調整與輔助固定。
application.en: For die pressure adjustment and auxiliary fixing.

application.zh: 特殊設計中間弧度增加吸力，適用於紙張搬運與進紙。亦販售一般型。
application.en: Specially designed with curved center for enhanced suction. Ideal for sheet feeding and handling. Standard type also available.

specs.zh: 特殊弧度型 / 一般型

application.zh: 矽膠材質，適用於需要更強吸附力的進紙作業。
application.en: Silicone construction for stronger suction in sheet feeding operations.
